title: Live stream: configuration switch, live_stream on the server and binding on the agent
description:
Epic mimid-e64f; docs/design/binary-live-stream.md §5.2.

Chosen (Mark, 2026-11-20): JMAP stays the default; the stream sits behind a configuration switch on agent and server.

Names chosen by the agent for mimid-e64f (INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC):
- mimid-server: live_stream = true serves /mimid/live; false (default) leaves the route out (404).
- mimid-agent: binding = "jmap" (default) or "stream"; AgentConfig::binding (Binding::Jmap, Binding::Stream) in mimid-agent-core.
- No fallback from one binding to the other: nothing runs in production, so an agent set to the stream fails if the server does not serve it.
